entry_points.text: Common queries mirror setup for address and count with the same unknown-subtype remap, count returning shared plus private totals; creation delegates to the central creator and destruction releases only the container; older dispatch routes distributor and processor groups to the register path and accepts only two address kinds, register groups, count queries and initialization on existence probing.

exports.text: Redistributor setup is two-phase: validated allocation with successor, compat and overlap checks queued under config protection, then ordered per-CPU decode registration under slots protection with predecessor rollback and discard on failure; lookup walks list by selector.

Detach and reattach iterate bound CPUs releasing and requesting per-CPU interrupts with diagnostics on surprise failure; direct state reads per-CPU byte and bit presence; shareability downgrades outer to inner, inner maps to write-back and outer filters encodings.

Generation helpers build transient table descriptors and delegate to shared word access; line-level helper needs word-aligned selector; version 3 existence selects distributor, redistributor or system tables with alignment checks.

v3 ops expose set, query and existence with shared register accessor and direct maintenance copy under config protection; v5 exposes minimal init-only controls plus userspace PPI query returning stored low bitmap and zero upper half; existence covers address, count, maintenance, control and level-info.

hazards.text: User copy fetch faults abort before locking side effects and store-back failures become final status; count reinstallation and post-initialization maintenance installation abort busy without state change; list, lock, bitfield and processor helpers from other dossiers are treated as stubs.

Several inputs are silently ignored: reserved generation mode, private routing writes, unknown interface offsets, post-enable base stores and out-of-range deactivate identifiers, mode mismatches and priority indices; priority indices are range-checked and speculation-hardened before indexing.

Bulk registration walks processors in order, stops at first failure, unwinds predecessors and discards the fresh region leaving no partial state; host-side pending failures for hardware-backed interrupts emit rate-limited warnings with host numbers while emulation continues without retry.

invariants.text: Address kinds cover older distributor and CPU interface, newer distributor, legacy redistributor and indexed regions with 4K older and 64K newer alignment and fixed spans; legacy uses region zero with undefined sentinel when absent; indexed packs selector, base, count and flags demanding nonzero count and clear flags; collision is half-open interval test.

Interrupt count needs 32 granularity from private-plus-32 minimum to 1024 maximum, single-shot busy if shared count nonzero, deriving shared by subtracting private reservation; common dispatch remaps unknown address subtypes and gates initialization and pending-table controls; installation and initialization serialize on configuration protection with machine and nonblocking processor acquisition added for persistence.

Older decoding splits attributes into CPU lookup plus masked offset, newer uses CPU zero for distributor else rebuilds identifier from four affinities; existence needs word alignment and successful word resolution; resolution subtracts base, checks width permission and alignment and bounds per-interrupt selectors; misses read zero and writes succeed silently.

Line window covers usable private plus shared identifiers, reads report level-configured asserted lines, writes store levels regardless to decouple restore order; group installs per bit with hardware SGI property path else queue; pending iterates set bits from address-derived base, ignores guest SGI bits on older models, tracks sources, delegates hardware SGI changes and preserves physical lines on paired set and clear under per-interrupt spinlock.

Older miscellaneous reads report enable bit with derived counts and product, revision and implementer identity, only control is mutable with disabled-to-enabled kick scan; userspace revision writes must preserve other bits and select supported codes to permanently latch group writability; newer miscellaneous adds type, capability and identity with direct SGI gating; routing retains low affinities and resolves target CPU under lock.

Software generation decodes target set and mode with explicit, all-but-self, self-only and reserved no-op, recording source and pending; private routing is immutable, shared is masked to online CPUs selecting lowest set bit; source bitmaps drive pending; CPU interface maps controls, shifted priority mask, binary points and identity with architecture version two; deactivate-by-write dispatches by host type with mode, tag, source and fold rules; priority view is index zero on older hosts and indexed on newer.

A redistributor is last only at region end without an immediate successor start; type combines low affinity, CPU identifier, message-interrupt capability when present and last flag; property and pending base sanitizers force reserved ranges to zero.

locks.text: Older register access copies user words before locking, then takes machine protection, tries all virtual CPU locks without waiting, then configuration protection, releasing in reverse and aborting busy on contention without side effects; newer distributor control writes hold configuration protection across the read-modify decision for enable state.

Redistributor base and synchronization state use lock-free atomics with single read plus 64-bit compare-exchange retry and sanitized merge, and counted busy with ordering barriers visible through the synchronization register.

state_machines.text: Pending persistence requires initialized distributor; with direct-interrupt support all processors detach before the scan and reattach after even on failure; the scan skips unresolvable or untargeted entries, caches guest byte reads, refreshes capable latches from hardware and writes back only on difference, aborting on first guest access fault.

Newer register access bypasses generic copying for system registers, otherwise copies a word before locking; after machine, processor and configuration acquisition it allows only allowlisted distributor identifiers before initialization, then dispatches to distributor, redistributor, system or line-level handlers with selector masking and copy-back on successful reads.

Message-interrupt control is active only with translation support: disabled moves to enabled by one atomic transition, enabled moves to disabled through transient busy with flush and cache invalidate, ignoring redundant requests and adding fixed capability bits on newer revisions; base reads return byte slices hiding one flag; invalidates ignore upper-half, disabled or sub-range identifiers and otherwise raise per-CPU busy during work.

structs.text: Device operations hold name plus create, destroy, set, query and existence handlers per version; older tables bind distributor and CPU offsets to handlers with density and widths; newer tables split per-interrupt groups into zero-read private window and real shared window plus dedicated global handlers with fixed sizes and 1, 2, 8 and 64-bit strides.

Redistributor identity combines virtual product code in the high byte with implementer code; discovery reports fifty-nine at the compliance offset and zero elsewhere; only two distributor identification registers are accessible before initialization.
